anchors.title: Adobe Rent a Car pickup
anchors.note: Bring passport, license, Fidelity card, ARCDW pages.

anchors.title: Dragonfly check-in
anchors.note: ~1h15 drive from Limón. Conf 4W9K5ZP4QB, paid in full.

optionSets.name: Land and float
optionSets.blurb: Arrive, swim at Punta Uva beach, dinner at La NENA — the only night it's open before Thursday. El Dragon in town is the backup if you land hungry for Asian.

optionSets.name: Stretch the legs
optionSets.blurb: Finca la Isla on the way through Puerto Viejo (open Mon until 16:00 — tight after a 15:00 check-in, only if the car pickup is fast), then dinner at La NENA.

optionSets.name: Water day
optionSets.blurb: Kayak at 08:00, snorkel the point, lunch on the sand at La Sirena, couples massage at 16:00, dinner at Zaika.

optionSets.name: Sloths first
optionSets.blurb: Jaguar Rescue 09:30 tour, lunch at Spicy Coconut across the road (or back to La Sirena), afternoon kayak, dinner at Zaika or Pita & Hummus.

optionSets.name: Slow day
optionSets.blurb: Bikes from Dragonfly to Playa Chiquita and Cocles, SAGE for a beach afternoon, massage, dinner at Zaika.

anchors.title: Congo Bongo office closes
anchors.note: ~10 min drive from Dragonfly. After 16:00 keys are in the lockbox — confirm the code with Daan.

optionSets.name: Cocles morning
optionSets.blurb: Jaguar Rescue 09:30 (if not done Tue), lunch at Spicy Coconut, SAGE or Pita & Hummus, check in, dinner at Moca Beach.

optionSets.name: Cahuita today instead of Saturday
optionSets.blurb: Leave 07:15, snorkel at 08:15 and/or the coastal walk, lunch in Cahuita village, 50 min south to Congo Bongo before 16:00, dinner at Moca Beach. Frees Saturday for a slow morning.

optionSets.name: Straight to Manzanillo
optionSets.blurb: Check in early, short walk in the refuge (closes 15:00), swim, dinner at Moca Beach.

optionSets.name: Boat day
optionSets.blurb: Sherman's boat at 08:00 with the Punta Mona farm add-on, slow afternoon, dinner at Pita & Hummus (25 min) or walk to Maxi's.

optionSets.name: Hike day
optionSets.blurb: Refuge trail to Playa Bite or Punta Mona from 06:30, snorkel off the village on the way back, lunch at Moca Beach, massage late afternoon, dinner at Zaika.

optionSets.name: Do both
optionSets.blurb: Boat at 08:00, short refuge walk after lunch — be back by 15:00.

optionSets.name: Waterfall + chocolate
optionSets.blurb: Breakfast at bread what what, Rios hand pies for the trail, Two Waters or Ma-Cu before 10:00, Cacao Trails (or the Kekoldi family), Finca la Isla in the afternoon, dinner at Grow.

optionSets.name: Puerto Viejo only
optionSets.blurb: bread what what, browse town, Finca la Isla, beach at Playa Negra, dinner in town at Grow, Umi Rojo (sushi) or El Dragon — or La NENA on the way back.

optionSets.name: Stay south
optionSets.blurb: Refuge trail or Sherman's boat if not done Thursday, Moca Beach, dinner at Maxi's.

warnings: Inland options are ~35 min from Manzanillo.

anchors.title: Adobe return — Limón downtown
anchors.note: Office closes 17:00. Return with a full tank.

optionSets.name: Cahuita snorkel + walk
optionSets.blurb: Leave 07:00, snorkel at 08:15, 45 min on the coastal trail, lunch in Cahuita village, leave 13:45, Adobe by 14:45.

optionSets.name: Cahuita walk only
optionSets.blurb: Refuge dawn walk 06:30–08:00, leave 08:45, coastal trail 09:45–12:30, lunch in Cahuita village, leave 13:45.

optionSets.name: Slow exit
optionSets.blurb: Beach morning at Manzanillo, early lunch at Moca Beach (closes 17:00 Sat), leave 13:45 direct to Limón (1h15).

warnings: All bags are in the car at Cahuita — paid lot at Kelly Creek, nothing visible.
Latest departure from Manzanillo direct to Limón: 13:45.
Saturday hours differ: Moca Beach closes 17:00, Rios Vegan closes 12:00.
